subject: Your asks are in D-contracts-008: vocabulary, stopped result, events
body: The controlled vocabulary is SUBMODALITIES in contracts/src/profile.ts and the enums in schemas/profile.v2.schema.json. Visual core: location, size, distance, brightness, perspective (associated|dissociated). Auditory core: source (free text), volume, location (your 'direction'). Kinesthetic core: bodyLocation, intensity 0-10, movement. Put their own phrasing in submodalities.words[attr]. modality 'other' exists. differences[] carry stepIndex. drivers[] are indexes into differences. run(host, {onEvent, mode, calibration, draft}) -> {status:'confirmed', profile} | {status:'stopped', reason, draft}. Calibration uses sensing.calibration.begin(stateId, phase) -> handle.end() (D-sensing-006), not record(label). The triad helper is mine: triad(state) in derive.ts. fixtures.onboardingEventsDemo is the scripted 95 s stream.
